kind.instructions: What kind of message is this, judging from the text alone?

criteria.bill: a bill, invoice, rent or payment that I owe and must pay
criteria.scam: a scam or phishing attempt: asks me to click a link, log in, or pay through an unusual channel
criteria.invite: an invitation to an event or gathering
criteria.appointment: a confirmation or reminder of an appointment, delivery or booking
criteria.ad: marketing or a promotion I did not ask for
criteria.personal: a personal message from someone I know that expects a conversation
criteria.other: none of the above clearly fits

urgency.instructions: How soon does this message need my attention?
criteria: no action needed or can wait a week
should be handled within a few days

needs_reply.instructions: Does the sender expect me to reply?

asks_to_click_or_login.instructions: Does the message ask me to click a link, log in, or enter account details?
